finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Arnold is fully aware of what would happen if he decides to make Earth an enemy,” Jake said. “I don’t question if he’s powerful and would be hard to deal with, but I’m confident that should push come to shove, I would be the one walking away alive. Suppose he does decide to join another faction. I seriously doubt we would suffer anything outside of losing him as an ally. At least he won’t do it by turning on Earth but simply by leaving us behind and going somewhere else to avoid making us, or more accurately me, an outright enemy.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “I trust in Arnold’s intelligence and ability to assess his situation and the climate he finds himself in,” Jake responded.
